name: Bollox
overview: Lots of kids are ANGRY! Whether it's at your parents because you're not allowed to have a dog or because you're worried about climate change. It's all possible. But dealing with emotions, is that still something we can do? It doesn't seem like it. Time to teach children how to manage this anger. But wouldn't that be boring? Not in Bollox! In this program, angry kids create their own message with angry punk music. With screaming guitars and pounding drums. Bollox is about big world issues or even the seemingly small things that make children angry. In Bollox, they find an outlet.
